name: Victory rolls
summary: Raised sections of hair rolled inward and pinned above the forehead or temples, a style worn in the 1940s.
intro: Front or side sections are lifted, rolled inward into a tube, and anchored with pins. The raised shape and visible opening give the roll its characteristic profile.
Rolls can be paired evenly or arranged at different heights. The rest of the hair can hang in waves or be swept into an updo.

variations.name: Paired victory rolls
variations.description: Two similarly sized rolls frame the front of the head.

variations.name: Asymmetric victory rolls
variations.description: A larger roll sits above one temple with a smaller roll on the opposite side.

variations.name: Victory roll updo
variations.description: The remaining hair is pinned up behind the rolls.

consultation.intro: Choose the placement from a front view and discuss whether the remaining lengths will be worn down or pinned up.
questions: Would you like the front rolls to match in height?
Which way should the openings face?
Should the back be waved or pinned up?
consultation.sampleRequest: “I’d like two open rolls above the temples, with one slightly larger and the remaining hair pinned low at the back.”

considerations: The front and side sections need enough length to wrap into a stable roll.
Check the outline from both sides before pinning, especially if the rolls differ in size.
